data.title: Vivy · 无人舞台的白蓝花嫁
data.description: 【游乐园无人剧场·清晨】Vivy穿着白蓝色舞台婚纱站在空舞台中央，耳机与白靴被礼花灯光勾出轮廓；她把一束小白花放在钢琴上，向镜头唱出只为一个约定保留的无声开场。
data.action: 空舞台中央把白花放上钢琴，向镜头完成只为约定保留的无声开场
data.lighting: clear dawn light across stage dust and white boots
data.mood: 为约定而唱的 AI 花嫁
data.promptProse: Vivy stands at the empty theater's stage center in a white-and-blue bridal stage dress with covered shoulders, veil, earpiece and white boots. She places small white flowers on the piano, then faces the viewer for the opening phrase held for a promise. The vertical medium-full view keeps piano and empty seats distinct. Clear dawn light reveals suspended stage dust and veil folds, with pale highlights on the boots and a long platform shadow.
